## Air, light, heat and moisture

Roasted beans go stale through contact with oxygen, light, heat and moisture. Keep them in an opaque airtight container at room temperature, away from the stove.

## The fridge and the freezer

Do not keep everyday beans in the fridge, where they absorb odours and condensation. Freezing is fine for long-term storage if the beans are sealed in small portions and each portion is thawed only once.

## Peak flavour

Most beans taste best between about 4 and 21 days after the roast date.
